defect: The new vertex preview sets glViewport(x, -y, fw, fh) and an ortho of the scaled content size (fw, fh) instead of the texture size, so vertices are misplaced when the framebuffer is scaled or offset.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these two added lines (viewport y and ortho TexWidth/TexHeight), and the commit says the previous code only happened to work.

defect: The fix stops SubmitPending from submitting presentCmd on a Pending submit so a second backbuffer step can keep recording into it.
reason: At d0016ad the presentCmd was only submitted in the final submit; the early Pending submit that leaves presentCmd pending was added later (c7322ed/f6cb6c7), so the moved code was correct for its callers.

defect: The added SubmitPending(Pending) call before acquire ends and submits presentCmd when a second backbuffer render step occurs in a frame, after which vkBeginCommandBuffer is called on the still-pending presentCmd and crashes.
reason: The fix removes the added assert, guards the begin, and makes SubmitPending skip presentCmd for Pending, repairing the crash created by this change's early submit.

defect: The added dc.Begin() in ImageView::Draw restarts the UI draw batch (count reset without flush, pipeline/texture rebound), breaking drawing of the main-screen icon and previously batched UI.
reason: The fix 'Fix mainscreen icon' removes exactly the dc.Begin() line this change added.

defect: The fix converts leftover ML_IMM/ML_ARMREG_IMM states of statically allocated registers to ML_ARMREG during FlushAll and replaces the empty none array by nullptr.
reason: The IMM handling for static registers it repairs was written in later commits (4920f3e, 2a8560e, b73920f); the empty array change is cleanup since the file is not built with MSVC.

defect: The change introduces a global template named Rect, which collides with the Rect type from Apple system headers and breaks the iOS build.
reason: The fix renames the Rect<T> uses this change added to DisplayRect<T> to fix the iOS name collision.

defect: The fix adds DIRTY_FOGCOEFENABLE to the through-mode dirty flags in Execute_VertexTypeSkinning.
reason: DIRTY_FOGCOEFENABLE did not exist at 878a049; it was introduced later (26c748f/a73ccd7), which missed this spot.

defect: The new Qt4 path calls image.convertToFormat(Format_ARGB32) without using its result (and omits it in pngLoadPtr), so the new ARGB-to-RGBA swizzle reads unconverted data and the buffer is sized for the unconverted image.
reason: The fix assigns the convertToFormat result in the lines this change wrote and sizes the output as width*height*4.

defect: The added unconditional __KernelSwitchOffThread on vblank reschedules even when interrupts are disabled.
reason: The fix removes the added call and instead uses PSP_INTR_ALWAYS_RESCHED with the interrupt-enabled check, fixing the alarm test.

defect: The fix switches the audio mutex to the native recursive_mutex and replaces manual lock/unlock with lock_guard.
reason: The lock/unlock pairs written by this change are balanced; the fix is a RAII and mutex-library cleanup, not a repair of a defect from this change.

defect: The fix replaces std::bind(..., placeholder::_1) event bindings with the OnClick.Handle helper.
reason: This is a cleanup to a new helper API; the std::bind bindings worked.

defect: The rewritten check calls gpu->PresentedThisFrame() without the null check the old condition had, crashing when gpu is null (loading a ppdmp while another is displayed).
reason: The fix restores the gpu null check on the line this change rewrote.

defect: The added null-shader check in CreateGraphicsPipeline returns false from a pointer-returning function and leaks the already allocated pipeline.
reason: The fix replaces the added return false with delete pipeline; return NULL.

defect: The added __KernelReSchedule inside the loop over chan.waitingThreads can re-enter __AudioWakeThreads and modify the vector while it is being iterated, causing a crash or race.
reason: The fix moves the reschedule this change added out of the loop, after all threads are woken.

defect: The fix unifies the D3D9 and D3D11 projection matrix multiplication order in the generated HLSL.
reason: The commit calls it an old inconsistency; this change only removed the D3D11_LEVEL9 branch condition and did not introduce the differing paths.

defect: The fix makes MergeRPTypes OR together the depth and input bits of render pass types instead of returning the first type.
reason: At caff2ea only BACKBUFFER and COLOR_DEPTH existed, so MergeRPTypes was correct; the unhandled COLOR/INPUT types were added later (ce82fce, 8e30a7c).

defect: The fix reorders the RenderPassType enum so depth and input are bits that can be OR-ed in MergeRPTypes.
reason: The enum from this change had only two values; the merge problem comes from types added later.

defect: The added guard makes Core_Break a no-op unless the core is in CORE_RUNNING_CPU, so the loaders' Core_Break(start-break) in CORE_POWERUP no longer breaks on load.
reason: The fix for the break-on-load regression stops calling Core_Break from the loaders, working around the guard this change added (plus a typo fix in its message).

defect: The fix sets CORE_STEPPING_CPU directly instead of calling Core_Break when starting with a break.
reason: At df104e7 Core_Break worked in CORE_POWERUP; the regression came from the guard added later in 474e7ac.

defect: The added if(Memory::IsValidAddress(bufferPtr) in sceNetEtherNtostr is missing a closing parenthesis, a compile error.
reason: The fix adds the missing parenthesis to the line this change added.

defect: The new Clickable::Key clears down_ for any key event when the view is not focused, so the mouse-button key event SDL sends after the touch-down cancels the highlight.
reason: The fix exempts DEVICE_ID_MOUSE events in the HasFocus check this change added; before it, Key did nothing.

defect: The fix makes iLanguage and iButtonValue static.
reason: No other translation unit defined these names, so this is encapsulation, not a link or behaviour fix.

defect: The new scePowerRegisterCallback and scePowerUnregisterCallback index powerCbSlots with an unchecked guest slot (e.g. -1 for auto), writing and reading out of bounds, and never clear the slot.
reason: The fix rewrites these added functions with -1 auto-slot handling, bounds checks and slot clearing.

defect: The fix comments out the debug assertion in the vuc2i case of Int_Vx2i.
reason: The assertion is an intentional debug diagnostic for a known-unreliable op; removing it changes no release behaviour.

defect: The added lookup of GetQueueFamilyProperties(GetGraphicsQueueFamilyIndex()) in VulkanProfiler::Init runs before the queue family is chosen, indexing queue family -1.
reason: The fix asserts a valid index and moves profiler Init after queue selection, repairing the lookup this change moved into Init.

defect: The fix changes the smoothed CLUT lookup factors from 32/256 and 64/256 to 31/256 and 63/256.
reason: The 32 and 64 factors predate this change, which only renamed mul to factor and added unsigned literal suffixes.

defect: The fix uses the vertex or material ambient alpha instead of 1.0 in the lit color.
reason: The hard-coded alpha 1.0 existed before; this change only added clamping around it.

defect: The added pspFileSystem.UnmountAll() in __IoShutdown unmounts every filesystem, including mounts owned by others, breaking filesystem mounting.
reason: The fix for the mounting bug introduced in #14638 replaces this change's UnmountAll with unmounting only the devices sceIo mounted.

defect: The fix writes gl_FragCoord.z with a depth_unchanged layout instead of 0.0 to allow early fragment tests.
reason: The stencil upload pipeline has depth writes disabled, so writing 0.0 changed no output; the fix is an optimisation.

defect: The fix flips the invertedY test and ySign for buffered rendering in the non-through rectangle UV rotation.
reason: The fix follows f4248cb, which changed the flipping convention for buffered rendering just before; the check from this change matched the convention of its time.

defect: The fix also negates matrix elements 1, 9, 4 and 8 when flipping the projection matrix, and removes a stray line-continuation character.
reason: The missing elements predate this change; the stray line continuation joined an empty line and was harmless.

defect: The fix passes the destination renderScaleFactor to BlitUsingRaster instead of using the global renderScaleFactor_.
reason: The global scale factor use came with the later draw2D_.Blit code; this change only passed pipelines instead of shader enums.

defect: The fix corrects the bone matrix number mask in the disassembler and the FramebufPixeFormat typo.
reason: The bone mask predates this change; the typo this change wrote is a cosmetic debugger string, not a functional defect.

defect: The new MIDI callback decodes MIM_DATA bytes from dwParam2 (the timestamp) instead of dwParam1, and the non-Windows stubs lack the includes they need.
reason: The fix switches to dwParam1 and adds the missing includes to code this change added.

defect: The fix works around a PowerVR driver bug with equality alpha test plus discard and uses mediump in roundTo255th.
reason: PowerVR kept the same rounding-and-compare approach as before this change; the commit treats it as a driver bug that was probably already present.

defect: The added MainWindow::TranslateMenus() in UpdateUI runs from the emu thread on every UI update, retranslating already translated menu text used as keys.
reason: The fix replaces the added call with a posted WM_USER_UPDATE_UI message and keeps the original menu keys.

defect: The fix renumbers the custom WM_USER messages to consecutive values and adds WM_USER_UPDATE_UI.
reason: The values WM_USER+100 and +200 did not collide with any other message, so the renumbering is cosmetic.

defect: The added ReadFramebufferToMemory call in SetRenderFrameBuffer reads the current framebuffer mid-frame on every call and unbinds the FBO without rebinding it, causing rendering glitches.
reason: The fix removes this call from SetRenderFrameBuffer and reads framebuffers at the start of the next frame.

defect: The fix corrects the POST content type to application/x-www-form-urlencoded and adds a game_title parameter.
reason: The content type line predates this change, and the added parameter is a feature.

defect: The change puts the round_to_zero = false default argument on the out-of-class VCVT definition instead of the header declaration, so the 4-argument call in ArmCompFPU.cpp does not compile.
reason: The fix removes the default from the definition this change wrote and adds it to the header declaration.
